camera_off.requirement: camera disabled before room cruise validation

health_ok.requirement: sensor health OK, safety allow true, watchdog not stopped

idle_no_motion.requirement: IDLE state, zero command/PWM, no relevant measured creep

lidar_ready.requirement: front clearance and LIDAR confidence ready for movement

logger_ready.requirement: logger has no drops/write errors and bounded queue/flush latency

required_peripherals.requirement: lidar, encoder and atomic BNO055 imu enabled
